title: Open every electrical terminal while retaining the component
statement: A 3.2x2.6x.254mm alumina carrier has eight .4mm-pitch underside pads and accessible test lands. A captive M0.8x0.2 drive retracts a 2.6x2.2mm contact platen by .25mm; .10mm nominal open gap and at least .05mm installed clearance are required, with incoming contact-height gating. Available GT contacts do not qualify the custom force/resistance/recovery or life. This is a physical intermediate-state design rather than a software isolation flag.

requires: Eight-sector optical head: 56 functional parts, 136 specified terminal-to-net joins on 43 nets, 32 submillimetre passives plus eight qualifying amplifiers, nominal complete 24.9 mm cube. Three noncoplanar layouts share component stock and a paid external instrument. Individual component ownership, electrical opening, diagnosis, tool capture, full extraction route, reconnection, installed functional proof and return-to-ready are distinct operations.

assumptions: The mechanism is a design and executable route/campaign report, not a fabricated apparatus. Rigid-envelope collision screens omit some flexible wires, deflection and continuous tool motion. Maker points do not qualify custom contacts, ceramic recovery, force distribution, photodiode/LED operating point or high-impedance leakage. Probe force can alter the measured contact. The matched conventional construction receives equal geometry, access and automatic test. Neither threefold complete speed nor 30% cost improvement is achieved; proposed physical experiments are unexecuted.

obstruction: Physically qualify retained isolation, contact opening, probe-free acceptance, full interior withdrawal, repeated reconnection and stock renewal with a competent solder control. The supplied 27384USD smaller test is a proposal, not spending or execution authority. No new experiment, source recovery or scientific replay is performed for publication.
